company.name: AVATOR AI TECHNOLOGIES
company.description: AVATOR AI TECHNOLOGIES is an independent AI technology company building applied intelligence systems — language systems, autonomous agents and complete software platforms engineered for the real world.
company.tagline: Intelligence, engineered into systems that hold.

facts: AVATOR AI TECHNOLOGIES is an early, independent AI technology company founded by Hridoy Samadder, operating from Barguna, Bangladesh, building for a global market.
There are currently no publicly released products or public APIs. The first product line and the developer platform are in private development; releases will be announced on the website first.
AVATOR does not publish certifications (no SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA or SLA claims), customer names, or usage metrics. Enterprise engagement is a direct conversation with the engineers.

Enterprise conversations cover: data boundaries, private/dedicated deployment models, security review with the people who built the system, and custom agreements — design-partner terms for organizations willing to build early.
Developers can request early platform access by email; early developers get direct engineering contact and a say in the interface.

technologies.title: Language Systems
technologies.summary: Applied language intelligence — systems that read, reason over and act on human language, engineered into working software rather than demos.
capabilities: Conversational interfaces built for real operational work
Retrieval and grounding over private knowledge
Structured extraction from unstructured text
Multilingual operation, including Bangla and English

technologies.title: Autonomous Agents
technologies.summary: Software that plans, executes and verifies multi-step work — under explicit constraints, with humans holding the controls that matter.
capabilities: Multi-step task planning and execution
Tool use across software, data and web surfaces
Bounded autonomy with human checkpoints
Verification loops that check work before it ships

technologies.title: Applied Intelligence Platforms
technologies.summary: Complete vertical software where intelligence is load-bearing — operations, education and market tooling built end to end.
capabilities: Full-stack operational platforms for specific industries
Intelligence embedded in daily workflows, not bolted on
Offline-tolerant engineering for hard environments
Deployment, iteration and support as one practice

technologies.title: Interface Engineering
technologies.summary: The discipline of making advanced systems feel inevitable — high-performance web platforms, precise interaction and interfaces people trust.
capabilities: High-performance web application engineering
Design systems and interaction engineering
Accessibility and multi-device art direction
Interfaces for AI systems that stay legible under complexity

technologies.title: Data & Signal Systems
technologies.summary: Pipelines that turn raw operational and market data into live, decision-grade signal — the circulatory system beneath every AVATOR product.
capabilities: Data pipelines from messy real-world sources
Live dashboards and operational analytics
Market and time-series signal processing
Storage and retrieval designed for AI consumption

technologies.title: Research & Experiments
technologies.summary: The open edge of the ecosystem — model behavior studies, evaluation harnesses and prototypes that decide what AVATOR builds next.
capabilities: Model capability and behavior evaluation
Rapid prototype systems ahead of productization
Applied research into agent reliability
Field notes published as work matures

work.title: DSE AI Trader
